description: Downloads videos, thumbnails and comments from Niconico.
pre_install: if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $savedDb -PathType Container) { throw "The persisted niconicome.db is a directory. Inspect and back it up before retrying." }
# LiteDB 5.0.11 initializes a zero-length file when Niconicome first opens it.
pre_uninstall: if ($journal -and $journal.Length -gt 0) { throw "Niconicome has a pending database journal. Close Niconicome cleanly and back up its data before retrying." }
throw "The active Niconicome database differs from Scoop persist. Back up both copies and reconcile them before retrying."
notes: Before updating, reinstalling, uninstalling or cleaning up an older Scoop install, close Niconicome and back up downloaded, backups, chrome, the database and its journal (if present) from every version directory and Scoop persist. Keep separate copies outside Scoop.
Scoop uses the existing installed manifest for cleanup. Follow the Niconicome migration steps in the bucket README before running Scoop commands.
Version 0.11.0 is pinned pending verification of prerelease database and addon migration.
